project.previewClosed: The window opened and closed right away.
project.previewNothing: The window is open, but nothing is shown in it yet.
sim.noMain: The program has no main function (or wWinMain), so there is nothing to run.
sim.noLoop: The window opened and closed right away: there is no render loop that keeps it open.
sim.noPresent: Nothing is shown: the frames are never presented ({call}).
sim.noPollEvents: glfwPollEvents is never called: the window would stop responding (and could not be closed).
sim.noClear: The frame is never cleared ({call}), so the window shows whatever was in memory – here black.
sim.drawOutsideLoop: {call} is called before the render loop: it draws once, and the next frame wipes it away. Draw inside the loop.
sim.glfwInitMissing: glfwInit() is never called, so GLFW cannot create a window.
sim.gladMissing: {call} (line {line}) is called before GLAD has loaded the OpenGL functions (gladLoadGLLoader): the program would crash here.
sim.noBufferBound: glBufferData (line {line}) is called with no buffer bound to that target.
sim.noVaoBound: {call} (line {line}) needs a vertex array object bound (glBindVertexArray) in the core profile. Nothing is drawn.
sim.uniformWithoutProgram: {call} (line {line}) sets a uniform, but that shader program is not in use: call use()/glUseProgram first.
sim.notCompiled: The {stage} shader is attached without being compiled (glCompileShader).
sim.notLinked: The shader program (line {line}) did not link, so it cannot be used.
sim.shaderSyntax: The {stage} shader in {file} did not compile, line {line}: {message}
sim.shaderFileMissing: The shader file {file} does not exist in the project.
sim.noProgram: {call} (line {line}) is called with no shader program in use (glUseProgram). Nothing is drawn.
sim.noElementBuffer: glDrawElements (line {line}) is called but the vertex array has no element buffer bound. Nothing is drawn.
sim.tooManyIndices: The draw call asks for {count} indices, but the element buffer has only {have}.
sim.readsPastEnd: {call} (line {line}) reads past the end of the vertex data.
sim.attribDisabled: Vertex attribute {location} ({name}) is not enabled (glEnableVertexAttribArray), so the shader reads (0, 0, 0, 1) for it.
sim.vkNoInstance: No Vulkan instance is created yet (vkCreateInstance).
sim.vkNoPhysicalDevice: The instance exists, but no GPU is picked yet (vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices).
sim.vkNoDevice: A GPU is picked, but there is no logical device yet (vkCreateDevice).
sim.vkNoSurface: The device exists, but there is no window surface yet (glfwCreateWindowSurface), so nothing can be shown.
sim.vkNoSwapchain: There is no swap chain yet (vkCreateSwapchainKHR): no images to show in the window.
sim.vkNoImageViews: The swap chain has no image views yet (vkCreateImageView).
sim.vkNoRenderPass: There is no render pass yet (vkCreateRenderPass).
sim.vkNoCommandBuffer: There is no command pool or command buffer yet (vkCreateCommandPool, vkAllocateCommandBuffers).
sim.vkNoSubmit: The command buffer is never submitted to the GPU (vkQueueSubmit).
sim.vkNoPresent: The swap chain images are never acquired and presented (vkAcquireNextImageKHR, vkQueuePresentKHR).
sim.vkNoWaitIdle: vkDeviceWaitIdle is not called before cleanup: the validation layer would report objects destroyed while in use.
sim.vkNoFenceWait: drawFrame never waits for the previous frame (vkWaitForFences): the CPU would race ahead of the GPU.
sim.vkNoApiHint: The window is created without glfwWindowHint(GLFW_CLIENT_API, GLFW_NO_API): GLFW would create an OpenGL context you don't need.
sim.vkNoRenderPassBegin: The command buffer never begins and ends the render pass, so nothing is cleared or drawn.
sim.vkLoadOpNotClear: The colour attachment's loadOp is {value}, not VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR, so the clear colour is not used.
sim.vkDrawOutsideRenderPass: {call} is recorded outside the render pass. Validation layer: draw commands must be inside a render pass.
sim.vkNoPipelineBound: {call} is recorded without a graphics pipeline bound (vkCmdBindPipeline). Nothing is drawn.
sim.vkDynamicStateNotSet: The pipeline makes {state} dynamic, but {call} is never recorded. Validation layer error; nothing is drawn.
sim.vkShaderNotLoaded: The shader {file} is not loaded (readFile) or its source is missing.
sim.vkNoVertexInput: The vertex shader reads {name} (location {location}), but no vertex buffer and vertex input description provide it.
sim.vkAttributeMissing: The vertex shader reads {name} at location {location}, but no attribute description has that location. Validation layer error.
sim.vkNoIndexBuffer: vkCmdDrawIndexed is recorded without an index buffer bound (vkCmdBindIndexBuffer) or index data.
sim.vkFillModeNonSolid: VK_POLYGON_MODE_LINE needs the device feature fillModeNonSolid enabled. Validation layer error.
sim.vkPushConstantsNotPushed: The shader has a push constant block ({type}), but vkCmdPushConstants is never recorded.
sim.vkNoPushConstantRange: The pipeline layout has no push constant range. Validation layer error.
sim.dxNoDevice: No Direct3D 12 device is created yet (D3D12CreateDevice).
sim.dxNoQueue: The device exists, but there is no command queue yet (CreateCommandQueue).
sim.dxNoSwapChain: There is no swap chain yet (CreateSwapChainForHwnd), so nothing can be shown in the window.
sim.dxNoRtv: There are no render target views yet (CreateDescriptorHeap, CreateRenderTargetView).
sim.dxNoCommandList: There is no command allocator or command list yet (CreateCommandAllocator, CreateCommandList).
sim.dxNoExecute: The command list is never executed (ExecuteCommandLists).
sim.dxNoFence: There is no fence: the CPU never waits for the GPU (CreateFence, Signal).
sim.dxNoBarriers: The back buffer is never transitioned between PRESENT and RENDER_TARGET (ResourceBarrier). The debug layer reports an error.
sim.dxListNotClosed: The command list is never closed (Close) before it is executed. The debug layer reports an error.
sim.dxNoShowWindow: ShowWindow is never called, so the window stays hidden.
sim.dxNoRenderTarget: Nothing is drawn: no render target is set (OMSetRenderTargets).
sim.dxNoPso: {call} needs a pipeline state object (CreateGraphicsPipelineState). Nothing is drawn.
sim.dxNoRootSignature: {call} is recorded without a root signature set (SetGraphicsRootSignature). The debug layer reports an error.
sim.dxNoViewport: No viewport or scissor rectangle is set (RSSetViewports, RSSetScissorRects), so nothing is drawn.
sim.dxShaderNotCompiled: No shader is compiled for the target {target} (D3DCompileFromFile).
sim.dxNoInputLayout: The vertex shader needs vertex data, but there is no input layout or vertex buffer view (IASetVertexBuffers).
sim.dxNoVertexData: The vertex data copied into the vertex buffer could not be found.
sim.dxNoIndexBuffer: DrawIndexedInstanced is recorded without an index buffer (IASetIndexBuffer) or index data.
sim.dxNoTopology: No primitive topology is set (IASetPrimitiveTopology), so nothing is drawn.
sim.dxConstantsNotSet: The shader reads the constants {type}, but they are never set on the command list.
